content.introduction: As of October 5, 2026, Bloomberg's sector performance data shows that Information Technology has the highest weight at 43% with a 0.72% change, followed by Health Care at 11% with a 0.75% change. Materials sector has the highest percentage change at 1.22%, while Industrials has the lowest at 0.05%. The overall All Sectors index shows a 0.64% change. The data is updated at different times, with the latest update being at 05:26 PM and 01:54 PM on the same day.
